A blowout tears open a gas line, venting a screaming white jet of pressurized vapor and spinning debris chunks into the black.
A red warning klaxon strobes across the entire dig site, painting every surface and suited worker in urgent, pulsing crimson light.
A cutting laser swings wide of its mark, the brilliant beam slicing across open space before the operator kills the power.
A loose slab calves off the asteroid face and tumbles in slow silence past a scaffold, grazing the upper rail with a grinding shudder.
A hauler fires its maneuvering thrusters inside the processing bay, the hot exhaust blast hammering crates and loose equipment across the floor.
A snapped tension cable uncoils in a savage whip-crack, the frayed end sweeping a lethal arc across the gantry deck.
The smelter overpressure relief valve fails, and a tongue of white-orange flame erupts from the housing in a roaring, shuddering burst.
Sparks cascade in a long golden curtain from a failing weld joint overhead, raining silently down across the machinery below.
A fine-particulate dust blast rolls outward from a drill impact, swallowing the near face of the worksite in a dense grey cloud.
A boulder dislodged from a high ledge tumbles end-over-end, missing a crouching technician by less than two meters before spinning away.
A pressurized coolant line ruptures at the coupling, spraying supercooled fluid in a wide fan that flash-freezes across the nearest panel.
A secondary klaxon ring activates deep inside the processing tunnel, its red pulse washing outward through drifting dust in stuttering waves.
An ore bucket on the conveyor derails and spills its load, heavy chunks of rock scattering in long lazy arcs across the pad.
A drill head seizes and kicks back violently, the whole rig lurching sideways and shedding bolts in a rattling spray.
A burst of laser fire from a mis-calibrated cutter chars a black furrow across the support strut of the nearest crane arm.
A loose gas canister, caught in thruster wash, spins off the rack and vents a twisting white spiral into the surrounding dark.
The rockface groans and a small cascade of gravel and fist-sized stones pours down the slope in a slow, spreading curtain.
A tethered platform swings hard on its lines after a cable pops, the whole deck canting at a sharp angle before catching.
A welding rig shorts catastrophically, throwing a sustained curtain of white sparks and a sharp crack of electrical discharge outward in all directions.
A hauler reverses blind in the staging area, its thruster cones sweeping dangerously close to a row of pressurized ore tanks.
A blowout seal on the extraction shaft gives way, and a roaring column of gas and pulverized rock punches straight upward.
The overloaded smelter vents a second burst, this one longer, the flame rolling outward in an orange sheet before the suppressor engages.
A thick cable lashes across the deck as its anchor bolt shears, the heavy line thrashing twice before going slack and still.
A drill-blast throws a dense wall of grit and fragments outward, the cloud catching the floodlights and turning the air opaque and gold.
A rock fragment, flung from the cutter, streaks past a helmet visor close enough to leave a white scratch across the faceplate.
